author: opus-5.5
body: [opus 5.5] Owner, 2026-10-08 17:18-17:33 CEST: do not hand-roll a Markdown renderer. Decision: render on the vibe-talk server with an off-the-shelf Rust renderer (comrak, GFM including bare-URL autolinks) plus the ammonia sanitizer, as crates.io and docs.rs do; send the page HTML rather than both HTML and raw text where the page does not need the raw text; turn on HTTP response compression (the server sends everything uncompressed today, voice.js alone is 836 KB); remove the page's hand-written renderer.
